title: Keep successes and errors apart
prompt: Write `readText(source: () => string): Result`. Call `source` once. If it returns a string, even an empty one, return `{ kind: "ok", text }`. If it throws, return `{ kind: "error", message }`, where `message` is the `Error` message, the thrown string, or `"Unknown"`.
hints: Put the call inside `try`. Build the error result in `catch`.
An empty string from `source` is still a success.
Narrow the caught value before reading `.message`.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats an empty successful result as an error.

feedback: Put the call inside `try`. Build the error result in `catch`.
